purpose.statement: Asset compliance policy rules generate policy violations on assets that are out of compliance with a security standard; violations can be assigned to an owner, tracked against an SLA deadline and prioritized with a severity score.

quotes: Policy rules are designed to generate policy violations on assets that are out of compliance with a given security standard in your organization.
Policy violations can then be assigned to a designated owner, tracked against a specific SLA deadline, and prioritized with a severity score.

permission.statement: Access to Policies requires a role with Read, Create and Edit permissions under the Assets App > Policy Rule resource.

quotes: For access to Policies, your assigned role must include the Read, Create, Edit permissions under the Assets App > Policy Rule resource.
For access to Policies, your assigned role must include the Read, Create, Edit permissions under the Assets App > Policy Rule resource.

admin-cannot-delete.statement: The policy creation page says the Asset Admin can create and manage policies but can't delete them; the policy management page says the same of users assigned the Assets Admin role.

quotes: The Asset Admin can create and manage policies, but can't delete them.
Users assigned the Assets Admin role can create and manage policies, but can't delete them.

creation-elements.statement: Creating a policy involves selecting the policy category, defining the asset population the policy applies to, and setting the policy scenario (the conditions that generate a policy violation).

quotes: Creating new policies for tracking asset compliance involves selecting the policy category, defining the asset population that the policy applies to, and setting the policy scenario (i.e., the conditions that generate a policy violation).

preview-top-50.statement: On the Create New Policy page, Preview tests the policy configuration and displays the top 50 policy violations it generates.

quotes: Click Preview to test and adjust the policy configuration. This displays the top 50 policy violations generated by the policy.

policy-violation-flow.statement: After a policy is created and saved, assets that violate it automatically generate policy violations, which are aggregated into violation tickets.

quotes: After creating and saving a policy, assets that violate the policy automatically generate policy violations
The policy violations are aggregated into violation tickets that can be tracked on the Violation Tickets page.

save-run.statement: Save applies a policy the next time data is ingested into the account, while Save & Run from the Save drop-down saves it and runs it immediately.

quotes: Click Save to save the policy. The policy will apply the next time data is ingested into your account.
In the Save drop-down menu, click Save & Run to save the policy and immediately run it.

manage-actions.statement: In the Policies table a policy can be edited, deleted, duplicated, processed immediately, and its runs can be viewed.

quotes: you can manage and adjust its settings and criteria in the Policies table, a centralized view of all policies.

creation-sections.title: What the policy creation sections contain and which policy categories exist
creation-sections.detail: The creation page lists sections (Details, Policy Criteria, Formatting Rule, Trigger Settings, Policy Violation Findings) without their fields, and the policy category values are not enumerated.
